Notes.Text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-28984,CVE-2026-43804,CVE-2026-64713,CVE-2026-64719,CVE-2026-64728,
  CVE-2026-64730,CVE-2026-64757,CVE-2026-64783,CVE-2026-64787: 
  WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit Security Advisory WSA-2026-0005 (bsc#1275791).

Changes for webkit2gtk3:

- Update to version 2.52.6
